posts.comment:
VISUAL FIRST: AF2.4 on one page. Backfilled under the rule that every ticket carries a visual and a document.

One page, landscape, built from the same data module as the document so a number on it cannot drift from a number in the document.

The one line worth reading: The ten projects were provisioned and NO PAGE SHOWED THEM.

posts.caption: AF2.4 Owner-scoped retrieval of the ten domain projects, 15 October 2026
posts.comment:
READY FOR ALI REVIEW - DOCUMENT. AF2.4, Owner-scoped retrieval of the ten domain projects.

The ticket asked: Make the ten provisioned domain projects reachable by the person accountable for each one. Delivered: Two routes and a database-backed owner-scoped reader, plus the measurement that showed why nothing was reachable before.

This is a BACKFILL. The work shipped in #3100 and the finding was real, but the artifact was never filed where the ticket said it would be, which is the gap your rule closes. The document carries the measured figures, the diagram, and a section stating what the work does NOT establish.

It also keeps what I got wrong first, rather than quietly overwriting it.

Review state unchanged. I do not close tickets.
